- Endpoints > Tools [PiAPI/Video Upscale-Get Task](https://piapi.ai/docs/video-upscale/get-scale.md): This endpoint from PiAPI's Video Upscale API retrieves the output of the Video Upscale task where users could check their task output.
- Endpoints > Tools [Video Remove Background](https://piapi.ai/docs/tools/video-remove-background-api.md): ## Overview
- Endpoints > Tools [PiAPI/Video Remove Background-Get Task](https://piapi.ai/docs/video-remove-background/get-scale.md): This endpoint from PiAPI's Video Remove Background API retrieves the output of the Video Upscale task where users could check their task output.
- Endpoints > PiAPI Account Management [PiAPI Account Info](https://piapi.ai/docs/account-info-api.md): Use the following endpoint to retrieve information such as account_name, account_id, remaining credits based on an API KEY.
- Endpoints > PiAPI Account Management [Task List Info](https://piapi.ai/docs/task-list-api.md): Get all your running jobs on PiAPI
- Endpoints > PiAPI Account Management [PiAPI/User History Query API](https://piapi.ai/docs/piapi-user-history-query.md): To enable users to access their history more conveniently and efficiently, we have provided a User History Query API.
